Kill + relaunch preserved the submitted inspection on both.
Android HOME + resume kept the form input; Windows minimize/restore stayed responsive.
Picker cancel on both at runtime; failed/superseded picker paths covered by unit tests.
No secrets; INTERNET permission removed; CI uses only the built-in GITHUB_TOKEN.
